description: Verify authentication and return the authenticated team and user identity.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds url, team, user, team_id and user_id for the authenticated admin; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get information about the current Slack team.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the team document; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List all users (members) in the team.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a members list of user objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get information about a single user by id.

user.description: The id of the user to look up.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the user; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Set the presence of a user to away or auto.

user.description: The id of the user whose presence is set.

presence.description: Presence value; 'away' sets away, anything else sets 'auto'.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds the new presence; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List channels, optionally filtered by type and archived state.

types.description: Comma-separated channel types to include (public_channel, private_channel).

exclude_archived.description: When true, archived channels are excluded (default true).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a channels list; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get information about a single channel by id.

channel.description: The id of the channel to look up.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the channel; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new channel, optionally private, owned by a user.

name.description: The name of the channel to create.

is_private.description: Whether the channel is private (default false).

user_id.description: The id of the user creating the channel (default U01AMELIA).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with the created channel; on failure (name taken), output contains an error message.

channel.description: The id of the channel to archive.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an empty object; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the user ids who are members of a channel.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a members list of user ids; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Invite one or more users (comma-separated) to a channel.

channel.description: The id of the channel to invite users into.

users.description: Comma-separated list of user ids to invite.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds an overall ok flag, per-user results, and the channel; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List top-level messages in a channel, newest first, with optional time bounds.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 20).

oldest.description: Optional lower-bound timestamp; only messages at or after are returned.

latest.description: Optional upper-bound timestamp; only messages at or before are returned.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a messages list and a has_more flag; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a parent message and its threaded replies.

channel.description: The id of the channel containing the thread.

ts.description: The timestamp of the parent message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a messages list (parent followed by replies); on failure (thread not found), output contains an error message.

description: Post a message to a channel, optionally as a threaded reply.

channel.description: The id of the channel to post to.

user.description: The id of the posting user (default U01AMELIA).

thread_ts.description: Optional parent message timestamp to post as a reply.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds channel, ts and the posted message; on failure (channel not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update the text of an existing message.

channel.description: The id of the channel containing the message.

ts.description: The timestamp of the message to update.

text.description: The new text for the message.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds channel, ts and text; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a message by channel and timestamp.

channel.description: The id of the channel containing the message.

ts.description: The timestamp of the message to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds channel and ts; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Add an emoji reaction to a message from a user.

channel.description: The id of the channel containing the message.

timestamp.description: The timestamp of the message to react to.

name.description: The emoji name of the reaction.

user.description: The id of the reacting user (default U01AMELIA).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an empty object; on failure (message not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search all messages for a case-insensitive substring in the text.

query.description: The substring to search for in message text.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output holds a messages object with total and matches; on failure, output contains an error message.
